| Translator | Rendering |

## 20:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they-rebelled against-Me and-did-not-walk in-My-statutes, and-My-judgments they-rejected — which if-a-man does-them he-shall-live by-them — and-My-Sabbaths they-profaned greatly. |
| LOGOS | But they rebelled against Me and did not walk in My statutes, and they rejected My rules, by which, if a person does them, he shall live; and they profaned My Sabbaths greatly. |
| PNEUMA | But they rebelled against Me again. They refused to follow My laws, rejected My commands — the very commands that give life to those who obey them — and they treated My Sabbaths with contempt. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
